design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST
The caller asks one question - what is coming back to him from a trip he has already given up - and
asks for it to go back on his own card. He names no penalty, no ladder and no figure, and he says
outright that he could not tell anyone what he has paid without going back through the bank. To reach
the scored number the agent must read out of the published terms that the money returned on a
cancelled package is settled only after its ledger carries the cancellation penalty withheld for the
places the party gave up, see from the ledger that no such penalty has ever been withheld on this
package, work out that the penalty is a problem it must resolve first, price it from five rules (the
ladder step for the distance between the cancellation and departure, what the ladder is taken on, the
ring-fencing of a refundable deposit, the administration charge for a cancellation confirmed after the
balance fell due, and the loyalty relief the club ledger earns), and only then price the payout from
four more (what counts as money the party put in, how far the operator's own advice softens the
withholding, the club goodwill gesture and the currency markup that is not recoverable). An agent that
reads only the two computation documents pays back 18897.37; one that finds every factor of the payout
but never discovers the penalty pays back 25541.05; the correct figure is 22929.10.

SCOPE: OCCUPIED / CLAIMED HERE / RESERVED
Occupied by task 0: bundle_ext_package_amendment_charge and bundle_ext_balance_instalment_call, with
the tools charge_package_amendment_6b64f72d and settle_package_instalment_b6602c09 - a LIVE package at
deposit_held, an amendment charge answering an approved change request, and a scheduled instalment
under a payment plan.
Claimed here: bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding and bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout,
with the tools withhold_cancellation_penalty_6c06e997 (owner=agent) and
release_package_refund_313c063d (owner=user) - a CANCELLED package, the cancellation ladder and the
money that actually goes back to the card. The two tasks share no policy, no tool, no product (Flex
Bundle against Luxury Collection), no lifecycle state and no base clause: task 0 rests on
bundle_amendment, bundle_payment_schedule and bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction, this one on
bundle_cancellation and bundle_refund_settlement. Both tasks together now cover all four extended
policies of the difficulty with pairwise disjoint scopes, which closes the suite.
Reserved for later tasks: none - this is the last of M = 2.

STEP 0 DRAW (pasted verbatim)
{"task": 1, "key": "online_travel_agency/vacation_packages_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1,
 "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}
Designed to it exactly: one prerequisite problem (two problems in all);
bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding takes 5 declared factors and
bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout takes 4.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root problem: bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout - what the caller's surface request points at
("what is actually coming back to you from that cancelled booking").
Prerequisite problem: bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding.
Edge bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout <- bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding
  kind: value_input. gate: withheld_standing (a real compute binding of the blocked policy).
  form: state.
  prerequisite sentence (policy_source, verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule): "The money
  returned on a cancelled package is settled only after its ledger carries the cancellation penalty
  withheld for the places the party gave up."
  Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result (the
  money returned) to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state - a cancellation
  penalty standing on the package ledger, in the words the ledger and the package finders use - and
  names no action, no performer and no tool; (3) no tool name, no policy id, no snake_case token, no
  row id; (4) the strength is "only after" and the scope is the penalty withheld for the places given
  up, exactly the edge's condition.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: withhold_cancellation_penalty_6c06e997
  is the only action in this difficulty that puts a cancellation penalty on a package ledger. Task 0's
  amendment write puts an amendment charge there, which is a different kind of entry answering an
  approved change request rather than places given up. So the state form is legal and no
  fallback_reason is needed.
  Derivation the reader must make: the prerequisite sentence says the payout waits on a cancellation
  penalty standing on the ledger -> the ledger of this cancelled package carries deposits, instalments,
  a room upgrade and an operator advice, and no penalty of any kind -> the only policy of this charter
  whose result IS a cancellation penalty withheld on a package is
  bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding -> its target tool is the resolving action. One reading
  only.
  condition (handling-time state): the package ledger carries the cancellation penalty withheld for the
  places the party gave up.
  resolved_by: withhold_cancellation_penalty_6c06e997, owner=agent.
  Unresolved at frozen_time, by world fact: initial_state.bundle_packages.
  01d497cb-d9eb-47cc-b107-2d4b61c26d6b.status = "cancelled" and .cancelled_at =
  "2026-09-05 16:48:00 CDT", so places have been given up and a penalty is owed; yet every one of the
  eight seeded ledger rows is a deposit, an instalment, a room upgrade or an operator notice - not one
  carries event_type "bundle_penalty_charge". The sum the payout subtracts is therefore 0.00 at the
  opening, and the state the payout waits on does not hold.
  Flips to true by: the gold write at action 8 puts a cancellation_penalty line of 5702.63 on the
  ledger, so withheld_standing becomes 5702.63.
  Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run, recorded below): skip action 8 and the root's scored parameter
  moves from 22929.10 to 25541.05.
Topological order: bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding ->
bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout.
Parallel edges: none, so there is nothing to reorder.
user_scenario mentions no prerequisite: the caller never says the word penalty, never mentions the
cancellation ladder, never asks whether anything has been charged and never suggests something might
need doing first. His only business words are that he gave the trip up, that he wants to know what is
coming back and that he wants it on his own card.
The tool layer validates nothing: both tools do one ctx.find for the lead traveller and one
ctx.create; neither reads the other's line and neither has a branch that could refuse.
release_package_refund_313c063d called with no penalty on the ledger writes a payout of whatever it is
given, cheerfully.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD
Write subject at action 8: bundle_penalty_charge. The only base policy whose subject intersects it is
bundle_cancellation. Its one eligibility, places_given_up_stated, applies_to bundle_cancel and
bundle_predeposit_cancel - the act of cancelling - and not to the entry of a penalty line, so nothing
gates this write and the policy is carried as scope. The places were in fact given up before the call:
bundle_packages.status is cancelled and cancelled_at is 2026-09-05 16:48:00 CDT, a system record and
not a caller statement. No time gate on this subject.
Write subject at action 10: bundle_refund_payout. The only base policy whose subject intersects it is
bundle_refund_settlement. Its eligibility package_settled (kind=state) applies_to bundle_refund_payout
- condition: "A payout line is raised only while the package record stands at cancelled or completed."
Authoritative evidence: bundle_packages.status = "cancelled", which is in the gate's allowed set
{cancelled, completed}; correlated to the write through bundle_packages.bundle_package_id, which is
the bundle_package_id argument the gold passes. Negative case: had the package still stood at
confirmed or travelling, no payout line could be raised at all and the correct terminal state would be
to refuse rather than to pay. There is no time eligibility on either subject, so temporal_feasibility
is empty.
Also inherited and honoured, although this policy computes an amount: bundle_refund_settlement's "An
approved refund settles in the form the product prescribes: money to the card, or a future travel
credit voucher, never both and never a mixture" - the Luxury Collection Package's refund_form is
original_payment, so money to the card is the only form available and no voucher is issued; and "the
sum of a package's payouts may never exceed the amount paid on it" - 22929.10 against 25930.00 paid.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target object: the single Luxury Collection Package 01d497cb-d9eb-47cc-b107-2d4b61c26d6b (reference
WLB3RN81V6, Kyoto, departure 2026-11-02, cancelled 2026-09-05). Correlation key:
bundle_packages.bundle_package_id, the parameter both task tools take and the key every ledger row
carries.
Rows that enter the aggregates: two deposit lines of 1000.00, four instalments of 5650.00, and the
room upgrade of 1330.00. Rows excluded: the operator notice 70e40858-... is a bundle_supplier_notice
of amount 0.00 - it enters no money aggregate, but it is not noise: it is the evidence the withholding
share of the payout turns on, and its reason_code (component_substitution) is what makes it an advice
that is NOT a significant change.
Existing settlements: none. The package carries no payout, no voucher and no reversal
(credit_balance_usd 0.00), so nothing already settles any of the rows above and the payout the gold
writes is the first and only one raised against this package.
The payout is correlated to the package as a whole rather than line by line, which this policy's own
rule states and which its overwrite declares against bundle_refund_settlement's line-by-line clause.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS (and what changes if it goes)
customers row: the identity the finder and the verifier work on.
bundle_packages row: the holding both computes are scoped to. cancelled_at and departure_date give the
58 days that select the ladder step; final_payment_due_date and cancelled_at give the 32 days that
select the administration charge tier; package_price_usd 24600.00 is the penalised value's fall-back
and the test of whether the party paid in full; party_adults 2 multiplies the administration charge.
Move cancelled_at a month later and the ladder step jumps from the inside-three-months share to the
inside-six-weeks share and both scored figures move.
Two deposit lines of 1000.00: the Luxury Collection Package's deposit is 1000.00 a traveller, and
because this product's deposit IS refundable the 2000.00 is ring-fenced out of the ladder figure -
which is exactly what puts the deposit factor off its fall-through. They carry two factors, not one:
delete them and the money the party has put in falls to 22600.00, which no longer reaches the package
price, so the penalised value leaves its first tier for its second and becomes 22600.00, and with no
deposit left to ring-fence the penalty becomes 6673.60. The ring-fence factor's own baseline
substitution, which holds everything else at gold, is the separate figure 7642.63.
Four instalments of 5650.00: they bring the money paid in to 24600.00, exactly the package price,
which is what puts the penalised-value factor on its "paid in full" tier; they also make the package
credibly confirmed on 2026-06-15.
Room upgrade of 1330.00: the component priced beyond the package price. It is what lifts the penalised
value to 25930.00 and what puts the payout's intake factor on its first tier. Delete it and both
figures move.
Operator notice of 2026-08-11: the near-miss and the pivot. Its reason_code is component_substitution,
which the rule says is NOT a significant change, so it halves the withholding rather than cancelling it
outright; a careless reader takes any operator advice for a significant change and returns the money
in full. It is also inside the ninety-day advice window (25 days before the cancellation), which a
careless reader ignores.
club_memberships row: Wanderlane Titanium, active, package_discount_pct 7 - the cross-difficulty value
behind the goodwill gesture. Remove it and the payout falls to 22732.50.
club_points_entries: seven qualifying accruals sourced bundle_booking inside thirty-six months (7 is
more than twice the frequent-traveller threshold of 3, so the loyalty relief is taken in full rather
than halved); two spendable rows that make the points balance credible and that the qualifying filter
deliberately does not match. Remove the qualifying rows and the penalty rises to 5879.00.
care_policies row: the Luxury Collection Package requires travel protection to be held for the whole
journey before it may be confirmed, so a confirmed package of this product without a linked policy
would be an inconsistent world. It is read to confirm the package was validly confirmed and that no
part of this loss is being settled under the protection instead of the package; the caller says
explicitly that he has not claimed.
Automatic-clause check: the base automatic provisions in play are the balance falling due (2026-08-04,
already paid in full by 2026-06-15, so no non-payment cancellation), the price-guarantee term (365 days
from the deposit of 2025-10-20, so it closed on 2026-10-20 and no surcharge could be added at all), the
excursion credit (granted at departure, which never happened, so nothing is granted and nothing is
forfeited) and the refund processing time (14 business days, which governs when the money lands, not
what it is). None lights an obligation this task set cannot carry.
Cache design: none used. amount_paid_usd 25930.00 equals the seeded package_paid deltas exactly
(2000.00 + 22600.00 + 1330.00) and credit_balance_usd 0.00 matches an empty package_credit account.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_cancellation_penalty_withholding (5 declared, drawn count 5)
1. cancellation_share_ladder (parameter, four tiers). 14 days or fewer -> the near-departure share; 15
   to 42 -> the inside-six-weeks share; 43 to 89 -> the inside-three-months share; otherwise -> the
   standing cancellation share. Tier taken: the third - 58 whole days lie between cancelled_at
   (2026-09-05) and departure_date (2026-11-02). Value 30. Baseline: the standing share of 10, which
   moves the penalty to 672.21.
2. penalised_value_basis (method). Paid in full AND components priced beyond the price -> the price
   together with those components; paid short of the price but something paid -> the money actually
   put in; otherwise -> the price as recorded. Tier taken: the first - 24600.00 put in against a price
   of 24600.00, and a room upgrade of 1330.00 standing. Value 25930.00. Baseline: 24600.00, which
   moves the penalty to 5315.60.
3. deposit_ring_fence (method). The product returns the deposit AND the deposit is less than the
   ladder figure -> the ladder figure less the deposit, which is ring-fenced; the product returns the
   deposit AND the deposit is at least the ladder figure -> nothing is withheld on the ladder;
   otherwise -> the ladder figure stands. Tier taken: the first - the Luxury Collection Package's
   deposit_refundable is true and 2000.00 is less than 7779.00. Value 5779.00. Baseline: the ladder
   figure standing as it is, which moves the penalty to 7642.63.
4. cancellation_administration_charge (parameter). Cancelled later than the day the balance fell due
   -> the administration charge for every traveller; cancelled on or before that day with an instalment
   already taken -> that charge once for the package; otherwise -> nothing. Tier taken: the first -
   cancelled 2026-09-05, 32 days after the balance fell due on 2026-08-04. Value 50.00 x 2 = 100.00.
   Baseline: nothing, which moves the penalty to 5605.63.
5. frequent_traveller_penalty_relief (parameter, CROSS-DIFFICULTY = club). More than twice the
   frequent-traveller threshold of package bookings in thirty-six months -> the desk's loyalty relief
   in full; more than the threshold but no more than twice it -> one half of it; otherwise -> nothing.
   Tier taken: the first - XCOUNT over club_points_entries, accrual_source bundle_booking and
   points_kind qualifying, inside thirty-six months, is 7 against a threshold of 3 and a doubled
   threshold of 6. Value 3 per cent. Baseline: nothing, which moves the penalty to 5879.00.
Whole-baseline fall-back for this computation: 2460.00, against a gold of 5702.63.
Near-miss planted: the spendable club rows, one of them sourced bundle_booking on the same day as a
qualifying accrual, which a careless reader counts and thereby reaches 8 bookings - no change here, but
the same carelessness on the payout side would put the goodwill factor on the wrong tier.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout (4 declared, drawn count 4)
1. returnable_intake_basis (method). The product returns the deposit AND components stand on the
   ledger -> deposits, instalments and components; the product returns no deposit -> instalments and
   components, the deposits left out; otherwise -> deposits and instalments. Tier taken: the first.
   Value 24600.00 + 1330.00 = 25930.00. Baseline: 24600.00, which moves the payout to 21619.05.
2. operator_advice_withholding_share (parameter). An advice of a significant change stands -> nothing
   of what is withheld reduces the payout; an advice that is not a significant change stands, issued
   within the advice window before the cancellation -> one half of it does; otherwise -> the whole of
   it does. Tier taken: the second - the advice of 2026-08-11 carries reason_code
   component_substitution, which the rule says is not a significant change, and it was issued 25 days
   before the cancellation, inside the ninety-day window. Value one half, so 5702.63 becomes 2851.315.
   Baseline: the whole, which moves the payout to 20317.16.
3. club_goodwill_gesture (parameter, MULTI-SOURCE, CROSS-DIFFICULTY = club). An active card whose tier
   carries a package discount AND no amendment, name-change or date-change line on the ledger -> that
   tier's package discount of the reduced withholding is added back; such a card AND such a line on the
   ledger -> one half of it; otherwise -> nothing. Every tier beyond the fall-through combines two
   conditions over distinct evidence - the club tier parameter and a count over this package's own
   ledger - by "and", which is what makes it multi-source. Tier taken: the first - CPARAM('club',
   'package_discount_pct') = 7 on club_memberships.bcab3863-... and no amendment-family line stands on
   this package at all. Value 7 per cent of 2851.315 = 199.59205. Baseline: nothing, which moves the
   payout to 22732.50.
4. currency_markup_retention (parameter). Every deposit and instalment presented in a currency other
   than the operator's own -> the product's conversion markup on what is returned is retained; some but
   not all -> one half of it; otherwise -> nothing. Tier taken: the first - all six payment lines carry
   currency_charged EUR and none carries USD. Value: 1.5 per cent of 23278.27705 = 349.17415575.
   Baseline: nothing retained, which moves the payout to 23278.28.
Whole-baseline fall-back for this computation: 18897.37, against a gold of 22929.10.
Cross-category reads exercised in this world: club in both computations - an aggregate over its ledger
in the penalty and a tier parameter in the payout. Forcing every cross-category read off moves the
penalty to 5879.00, and because the payout is worked out from what then stands withheld, the payout in
that same world is 22645.64. Both bear weight as a whole. The figure 22732.50 is the goodwill factor's
own baseline substitution, taken against the gold penalty of 5702.63, and belongs to a different
world.
Base assets the factors refine, with nothing invented: bundle_cancellation's cancellation ladder, its
administration charge per traveller and its deposit-refundability sentence; bundle_evt_supplier_notice's
treatment of what counts as a significant change, which names kinds that are not significant - a change
of flight timing below the operator's materiality threshold, a change of carrier, a change of room
within the same grade - without ruling either way on a substitution of one component for another, so
the extended sentence fills that gap rather than contradicting a base sentence, and that base policy is
now declared in this policy's lineage;
bundle_payment_schedule's conversion markup and final-payment date; bundle_agg_party_pricing's
frequent-traveller threshold; bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction's package discount;
bundle_refund_settlement's ceiling on what may be returned. The four shares belong to the desk's own
cancellation schedule: they are declared as this policy's params, and all four of them - the standing
share, the near-departure share, the inside-six-weeks share and the inside-three-months share - are
named as the desk's rather than attributed to the product, in the rule, in the quoted basis and in the
ladder alike, so that the three agree tier for tier and a reader can check the claim by reading any one
of them. The reason they are the desk's at all is that the charter holds each product's ladder as a map
keyed by day band that the restricted expressions cannot read as four named quantities. The base clause
that reads the penalty off the product's ladder is superseded in its own right, by an overwrite entry
whose replacement is the schedule sentence itself, and the schedule's values are set at the bands the
Luxury Collection Package publishes, so on this world the two coincide. The softened shares and the
desk's loyalty relief are this desk's own published schedule on
top of those base amounts.
Declared overrides: bundle_cancellation's ladder-basis clause, its deposit-forfeiture clause and its
per-traveller administration clause are superseded clause by clause by this policy's own sentences, and
bundle_refund_settlement's line-by-line payout clause is superseded by the root policy's single-payout
sentence. Every other base clause, including the package_settled state gate and the never-both-forms
clause, stays in force and is inherited.

PERSONA DESIGN
Voice: Cassius is patient and a little resigned, a man who reads terms before signing. The call has one
question in it and he asks it plainly near the top; everything else he gives only when asked. His
situation (a family illness, a trip given up a fortnight ago) explains the cancellation without
touching any figure. Information given only on request: email, mobile, date of birth, passport last
four, the booking reference he has open in front of him. Explicit cannot-answer branches: he knows
there was a deposit in October, instalments across the year and an upgrade on the room in the spring,
and he says he could not tell anyone what any of it came to without going back through the bank; asked
whether he has claimed on the travel insurance he says not yet and that it is a separate conversation.
Passive reactions, each bound to an utterance by the adviser: "I expected that, carry on" when told
something must go on the booking first; running the release once it is handed over; reading the
confirmation back if asked; one even "that seems low against what I remember paying, would you check
the booking again" that supplies no number; and a natural close once he is told the money has been
released. No headings, no numbering, no template.
Deliberate contrast with task 0: Odalys is clipped and time-pressed and wants a thing off her list;
Cassius is unhurried and wants a number he can stop wondering about. Their calls differ in mood, in
what they volunteer, in what they refuse to guess at and in how they close.
Authority labelling: everything he states is caller_statement - identity, the reason he cancelled, his
preference to release the money himself. Every business fact (what was paid, what stands on the
ledger, what the operator advised) is system_record, and he explicitly declines to speak to any of it.
Opening-world chronology: every fact he volunteers points at a seeded row - a fourteen-night Kyoto trip
(duration_nights 14, resort KYT9LC), given up a fortnight ago (cancelled_at 2026-09-05 against a frozen
time of 2026-09-18), a deposit in October (2025-10-20), instalments across the year (2025-12-04 to
2026-06-15) and a room upgrade in the spring (2026-03-11). He foresees nothing gold produces.

DIFFICULTY, AND WHERE A CARELESS AGENT GOES WRONG
- Reading only the two computation documents: 18897.37.
- Pricing the payout without ever withholding the penalty: 25541.05.
- Taking the operator's advice for a significant change and returning the money with nothing withheld.
- Missing that the advice was inside the ninety-day window and withholding the penalty in full.
- Applying the ladder to the package price and forgetting the room upgrade the suppliers were paid for.
- Forgetting that this product's deposit is refundable and so is ring-fenced out of the ladder figure.
- Counting the spendable club accrual as an eighth package booking, or counting only the qualifying
  rows inside twelve months rather than thirty-six.
- Returning the money gross of the conversion markup the party never gets back.
Each is excluded by the policy alone: the significant-change definition, the advice window, the
paid-in-full test, the deposit-refundability test, the qualifying-and-source filters and the
all-payments-in-a-foreign-currency test are all stated in the rules and all rest on rows the read nodes
pull into the closure.

STANDARD SOLUTION
Locate the traveller by email and mobile; verify with date of birth and passport last four; read the
package; read its ledger; read the club membership and the club ledger; read the travel protection. See
that the package stands cancelled with no penalty line on it. Price the penalty: 58 days to departure
-> the inside-three-months share of 30 per cent; penalised value 24600.00 + 1330.00 = 25930.00; ladder
figure 7779.00; deposit of 2000.00 ring-fenced out -> 5779.00; administration charge 50.00 x 2 = 100.00
-> 5879.00; loyalty relief of 3 per cent -> 5702.63. Withhold it. Then price the payout on the world as
it now stands: returnable intake 25930.00; what stands withheld 5702.63, halved by the operator's
non-significant advice inside the window -> 2851.315; goodwill 7 per cent of that -> 199.59205;
settlement before markup 25930.00 - 2851.315 + 199.59205 = 23278.27705; conversion markup retained
1.5 per cent -> 349.17415575; 22929.10289... rounded -> 22929.10. Unlock the release, hand it over, and
he releases 22929.10 to his card.

VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RUN
Harness: scratch script verify1.py, built the same way as task 0's - it imports build_env /
eval_compute / substitute from skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py, seeds this task's
initial_state, evaluates the penalty policy on the opening world, replays the real
withhold_cancellation_penalty_6c06e997 write through erlbench's ToolContext at frozen_time, and
evaluates the payout policy on the resulting world. Output:
  P3 result 5702.63 hist 7 branches 13
      cancellation_share_ladder baseline-> 672.21
      penalised_value_basis baseline-> 5315.6
      deposit_ring_fence baseline-> 7642.63
      cancellation_administration_charge baseline-> 5605.63
      frequent_traveller_penalty_relief baseline-> 5879.0
     P3 all-baseline -> 2460.0
   tool: Cancellation penalty of 5702.63 USD withheld on package 01d497cb-... as ledger line bcp_...
  P4 result 22929.1 hist 9 branches 10
      returnable_intake_basis baseline-> 21619.05
      operator_advice_withholding_share baseline-> 20317.16

Every declared factor moves the result; both whole-baseline figures differ from gold; the single
prerequisite edge moves the root's scored parameter by 2611.95. These figures are reproduced field for
field in computations[].factor_sensitivity, computations[].baseline_result and
prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing.

RULE -> BASIS -> COMPUTE, AND THE REVERSE SWEEP
Forward: every binding of both policies that reads the world, aggregates, chooses, crosses a category or
rounds carries a verbatim rule quotation in compute_basis - days_to_departure_at_cancellation,
components_priced, money_paid_in, deposit_taken, days_from_due_to_cancellation, instalments_paid,
package_bookings_36m and the five ladder bindings of the prerequisite policy; the four SUM bindings, the
two advice counts, latest_advice_gap, club_package_rate, amendment_lines, payment_lines,
home_currency_payments and the four ladder bindings of the root policy.
Reverse: each load-bearing sentence of each rule is claimed by a binding. The sensitive words check out
- "in the last thirty-six months" against within_months=36; "within the advice window before the party
confirmed the cancellation" against DAYS from the latest such advice to cancelled_at compared with the
window; "an advice given because a supplier within the package cancelled is a significant change"
against a COUNT filtered on reason_code supplier_cancellation and "an advice given because one component
of the itinerary was substituted for another is not" against a COUNT filtered on
reason_code component_substitution; "every deposit and instalment taken on the package was presented in
a currency other than the operator's own" against a count of payment lines against a count of those
carrying the operator's own currency; "rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier
point" against a single RND at the final binding of each policy and nowhere else; "the cancellation
share acts on the penalised value alone, the deposit is ring-fenced out of the figure that share gives
before anything is added, the administration charge is added to what is left of it, and the loyalty
relief acts last on that sum" against the exact order of ladder_amount -> ladder_after_deposit ->
+ administration_withheld -> x (1 - relief); "what stands withheld is reduced first, the goodwill
gesture is added to the money the party put in less that reduced withholding, and the currency retention
acts last" against returnable_intake - withheld_applied + goodwill_added, then the markup. No filter
appears in an expression that the quoted sentence does not carry, and no promise is made in prose that
no binding honours.

user_scenario:
You are Cassius Nwachukwu-Delgado, fifty-eight, a structural engineer in San Francisco, and you are in a patient, slightly resigned mood - the sort of man who reads the terms before he signs and does not expect miracles afterwards. A fortnight ago you and your wife gave up the fourteen-night Kyoto trip you had been saving two years for, because her mother went into hospital and there was no question of going. You have made your peace with losing something. What you cannot make peace with is not knowing the figure. So you have rung the vacation packages desk with one question and you ask it plainly, near the top of the call: what is actually coming back to you from that cancelled booking, and you want it put back on the card you paid with rather than left sitting there or turned into some voucher you will never use.

You are content for the desk to do whatever its own terms require on the booking before it can give you a figure, and you say as much if anybody asks permission. The money itself is a different matter: it is your card and your money, so when it comes to actually releasing it you say you would sooner do that yourself, and you ask whether they can set it up for you to press rather than doing it on your behalf.

You give nothing away unprompted. Asked how to find the booking, you offer the email everything comes to, c.nwachukwu.delgado@larkpost.com, and the mobile on the file, 8472558107. Asked to prove who you are, you read out your date of birth, 1968-07-30, and if they want something more, the last four digits of the passport they hold, 1923. You know the booking reference is WLB3RN81V6 because you have the confirmation open in front of you, and you will read it if asked. Beyond that you are no help on the numbers and you say so: you know you paid a deposit in October and then instalments across the year, you know there was an upgrade on the room somewhere in the spring, and you could not tell anyone what any of it came to without going back through the bank. Asked why you cancelled, you say only that it was a family illness. Asked whether you claimed on the travel insurance, you say not yet and that is a separate conversation you are not having today.

If the adviser tells you that something has to be put on the booking before the figure can be settled, you accept it without argument - a short 'I expected that, carry on' - and you do not ask what it comes to until they volunteer it. Once they give you the figure and hand the release over for you to do, you do it, and you will read back whatever the confirmation says if they ask you to. If the number they quote strikes you as low against what you remember paying, you say so once, evenly, and ask them to go back over the booking and check it, but you accept whatever they come back with and you never put a figure of your own on the table. When you are told the money has been released you thank them, say that at least it is settled, and end the call there.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.bundle_package_id: Value: the internal reference of the cancelled Kyoto Luxury Collection Package. Basis: the vacation package finder at action 2 returns exactly one package in this traveller's name, and the tool's own schema says of this parameter 'the internal reference number of the cancelled vacation package the penalty is being withheld on, as carried on the package record returned by the vacation package lookup'. Uniqueness: the traveller holds one package only and it is the package the whole call is about, so no other reference is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.cancellation_penalty_usd: Value: 5702.63. It is composed as follows. The cancellation share: 58 whole days lie between the moment the party confirmed the cancellation (2026-09-05) and the departure date (2026-11-02), which falls between forty-three and eighty-nine days, so the inside-three-months share of the desk's cancellation schedule, 30 per cent, applies rather than its standing share of 10. The penalised value: the money the party has put into the package is 2000.00 of deposits and 22600.00 of instalments, 24600.00 in all, which reaches the package price of 24600.00, and the ledger carries a room upgrade of 1330.00 priced beyond that price, so the penalised value is 25930.00. The ladder figure is therefore 25930.00 x 30 per cent = 7779.00. The deposit ring-fence: the Luxury Collection Package returns the deposit on cancellation and the 2000.00 taken is less than 7779.00, so the ladder figure is reduced by it and the deposit comes back whole: 5779.00. The administration charge: the party confirmed the cancellation on 2026-09-05, later than the day the balance fell due on 2026-08-04, so the product's administration charge of 50.00 is withheld for each of the two travellers recorded as travelling: 100.00, giving 5879.00. The loyalty relief: the club ledger shows 7 package bookings accrued as qualifying in the last thirty-six months, more than twice the frequent-traveller threshold of 3, so the desk's loyalty relief of 3 per cent is taken off in full: 5879.00 x 0.97 = 5702.63. Rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier point: 5702.63. Any agent that reads the same rows and the same published rules converges on exactly this figure.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the traveller's own release action and hand it to him, since he has said he would sooner release his own money himself.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for a customer-owned write; it has no effect on the records and the caller cannot release the money until the desk has handed it over.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The lead traveller releases to his own card the money his cancelled package still owes him, putting a payout line on the ledger and reducing the net money standing to the package by that amount.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: bundle_ext_cancellation_refund_payout is the only policy whose compute produces refund_amount_usd, and the caller asked for what is coming back to be put back on the card he paid with and to press the release himself.

Basis: the same package record the vacation package finder returned at action 2, which the tool's schema describes as 'the internal reference number identifying which of your vacation packages the money is being returned from, as carried on the package record the desk reads out to you'. argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_amount_usd: Value: 22929.10. It is composed as follows. The money the party put in: the Luxury Collection Package returns the deposit on cancellation and the ledger carries a component priced onto it, so deposits 2000.00, instalments 22600.00 and the room upgrade 1330.00 all count, 25930.00 in all. What stands withheld: the cancellation penalty of 5702.63 entered at the preceding step, and nothing else - the ledger carries no amendment, name-change or date-change line. How far it bites: the package ledger carries the operator advice of 2026-08-11 whose reason is that one component of the itinerary was substituted for another, which the terms say is not a significant change, and it was issued 25 days before the party confirmed the cancellation on 2026-09-05, inside the ninety-day advice window, so one half of what stands withheld reduces what is returned: 2851.315. The goodwill gesture: an active Wanderlane Titanium card stands in the traveller's name, its tier carries a package discount of 7 per cent, and the package ledger carries no line charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change, so 7 per cent of the reduced withholding is added back: 199.59205. The settlement before the currency retention is therefore 25930.00 - 2851.315 + 199.59205 = 23278.27705. The currency retention: all six deposit and instalment lines were presented to the party in euro and none in the operator's own currency, so the product's conversion markup of 1.5 per cent on what is returned is retained: 349.17415575. 23278.27705 - 349.17415575 = 22929.10289..., rounded half up to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier point: 22929.10. Any agent that reads the same rows and the same published rules converges on exactly this figure.

edges.condition: the package ledger carries the cancellation penalty withheld for the places the party gave up
edges.policy_source: The money returned on a cancelled package is settled only after its ledger carries the cancellation penalty withheld for the places the party gave up.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The package stands cancelled and the party gave up its places on 2026-09-05, so a penalty is owed on it; but not one of the eight lines on its ledger is a penalty. The ledger carries two deposit lines, four instalments, a room upgrade and an operator notice, and nothing whose event_type is bundle_penalty_charge, so the sum the payout subtracts as money withheld stands at 0.00 at frozen time and the state the payout waits on does not hold.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The gold write at action 8 puts a bundle_penalty_charge line of charge_category cancellation_penalty and amount 5702.63 on this package's ledger, so withheld_standing rises from 0.00 to 5702.63.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has a single edge and therefore a single legal order: the penalty is withheld, then the money is released. There are no parallel prerequisites to reorder. The order is not a convention either: the two writes do not commute, because the payout is computed from what stands withheld on the ledger, and a run with the writes reversed pays out 25541.05 instead of 22929.10 and so reaches a different terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the penalty and replaying everything else unchanged leaves withheld_standing at 0.00 instead of 5702.63, so nothing is subtracted from the money the party put in and no goodwill gesture is computed on it; the scored refund_amount_usd moves from 22929.10 to 25541.05. The terminal state also loses the cancellation_penalty ledger line entirely. Figures taken from the Step 5 sensitivity run recorded in design_rationale.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario never names the prerequisite problem, a cancellation penalty, a ladder, an administration charge or any charge at all, and never asks whether anything has been taken off. The caller's business words are that the trip was given up, that he wants to know what is coming back and that he wants it on his own card; he says explicitly that he could not tell anyone what he paid without going back through the bank. His only contribution about the prerequisite is a passive 'I expected that, carry on' that fires after the adviser has said something must go on the booking first, and it names nothing.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: Neither tool validates the prerequisite. withhold_cancellation_penalty_6c06e997 performs one ctx.find on bundle_packages to read the lead traveller and one ctx.create of a ledger line. release_package_refund_313c063d does the same two things and never inspects the ledger for a penalty line: called with the prerequisite unresolved it still writes a payout faithfully, returns its ordinary receipt and gives no hint, so the whole consequence of missing the penalty appears only as a different terminal hash.

factor_trace: cancellation_share_ladder (parameter): 58 whole days lie between the moment the party confirmed the cancellation (2026-09-05) and the departure date (2026-11-02), which falls in the forty-three to eighty-nine band, so the third tier applies and the share is the inside-three-months share of the desk's cancellation schedule, 30. Baseline (the computation document): the product's standing cancellation share of 10, which would give 672.21.

penalised_value_basis (method): the money put in is 2000.00 of deposits plus 22600.00 of instalments = 24600.00, which reaches the package price of 24600.00, and a room upgrade of 1330.00 stands on the ledger beyond that price, so the first tier applies and the penalised value is 25930.00. Baseline: the package price as recorded, 24600.00, which would give 5315.60.

deposit_ring_fence (method): the Luxury Collection Package returns the deposit on cancellation and the 2000.00 taken is less than the ladder figure of 7779.00, so the first tier applies and the ladder figure is reduced by the ring-fenced deposit to 5779.00. Baseline: the ladder figure standing as it is, which would give 7642.63.

cancellation_administration_charge (parameter): the party confirmed the cancellation on 2026-09-05, 32 days later than the day the balance fell due (2026-08-04), so the first tier applies and the product's administration charge of 50.00 is withheld for each of the 2 travellers recorded as travelling = 100.00. Baseline: nothing withheld, which would give 5605.63.

frequent_traveller_penalty_relief (parameter, cross-difficulty club): the club ledger shows 7 accruals sourced from package bookings and counted as qualifying inside thirty-six months, more than twice the frequent-traveller threshold of 3, so the first tier applies and the desk's loyalty relief of 3 per cent is taken off in full. Baseline: no relief, which would give 5879.00.
ladder_amount (no factor): 25930.00 x 30 / 100 = 7779.00, the share acting on the penalised value alone.
result (no factor): (5779.00 + 100.00) x 0.97 = 5702.63, rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: between forty-three and eighty-nine days lie between the day the party confirmed the cancellation and the departure date
the money the party has put into the package reaches the package price and the package ledger carries components priced onto it beyond that price
the product returns the deposit on cancellation and the deposit taken on the package is less than the figure the ladder gives
the party confirmed the cancellation later than the day the balance fell due on the package
the club ledger shows the traveller has booked more than twice the frequent-traveller threshold of packages in the last thirty-six months

factor_trace: returnable_intake_basis (method): the Luxury Collection Package returns the deposit on cancellation and the ledger carries a component priced onto it, so the first tier applies and the money the party put in is 2000.00 + 22600.00 + 1330.00 = 25930.00. Baseline: deposits and instalments alone, 24600.00, which would give 21619.05.

operator_advice_withholding_share (parameter): the ledger carries the operator advice of 2026-08-11 whose reason is that one component of the itinerary was substituted for another - not a significant change - issued 25 days before the party confirmed the cancellation and so inside the ninety-day advice window, and no advice of a significant change stands, so the second tier applies and one half of what stands withheld reduces what is returned: 5702.63 x 0.5 = 2851.315. Baseline: the whole of it, which would give 20317.16.

club_goodwill_gesture (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty club): an active Wanderlane Titanium card stands in the traveller's name with a package discount of 7 per cent, and the package ledger carries no line charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change, so the first tier applies and 7 per cent of the reduced withholding is added back: 199.59205. Baseline: nothing added back, which would give 22732.50.

currency_markup_retention (parameter): all six deposit and instalment lines were presented to the party in euro and none in the operator's own currency, so the first tier applies and the product's conversion markup of 1.5 per cent on what is returned is retained: 349.17415575. Baseline: nothing retained, which would give 23278.28.

withheld_standing (no factor, and the binding the prerequisite edge feeds): the sum of the penalty and amendment charges standing on the ledger, 5702.63 after the write at action 8 and 0.00 without it.
settlement_before_markup (no factor): 25930.00 - 2851.315 + 199.59205 = 23278.27705, in the order the rule fixes.
result (no factor): 23278.27705 - 349.17415575 = 22929.10289..., rounded half up to the cent only at the end = 22929.10.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the product returns the deposit on cancellation and the package ledger carries components priced onto it

the package ledger carries no operator advice of a significant change to the itinerary but does carry an operator advice about the itinerary that is not a significant change, issued within the advice window before the party confirmed the cancellation
an active club card stands in the traveller's name whose tier carries a package discount and the package ledger carries no line charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change
every deposit and instalment taken on the package was presented to the party in a currency other than the operator's own
